comparison_backrest.source: APTA PR-CS-S-016-99 Rev3.1 section3.1.1, comparison only

rear_fixed_foot_bound.strip_note: Illustrative gross elastic strip; real effective width, two-way bending, holes, contact and prying NOT established. Not an allowable or joint pass.

comparison_backrest.note: Both back-force signs; no occupant gravity credited to suppress uplift. Frame stiffness does not prove all force uses the full16in front/rear lever. Dynamic occupant protection and fatigue remain open.

combined_local_fixed_foot_sensitivity.source: Analyst simultaneous inertia case; rear-only half sharing bound, not established stiffness distribution
combined_local_fixed_foot_sensitivity.equation: Tmax=My/(4*a)+Mx/(4*b), a=0.875in,b=2in; symmetric group, no gravity/preload credit
combined_local_fixed_foot_sensitivity.limit: Not a complete force envelope or joint strength pass. Contact, prying, biaxial effective width, holes, welds, rail wall, fatigue and real frame/foot stiffness remain open.

comparison_front_edge.source: APTA section3.1.3 comparison,450lbf/place on5x5in patches nearfrontedge
comparison_front_edge.limit: Ideal front rail simple support24in. Actual overhang, pan plate contact, patch coordinates, welds, uplift and all adjacent members must be tested/reviewed. Total-force coincidence does not make inertia case equivalent.

fit.floor_gap_equation: 6.35mm minus measured adverse floor stack, spacer/sole/cap flatness and weld/loaded relative deflection must exceed engineer-selected minimum

example_adverse_budget_mm.status: Allocated target only; not measured/accepted tolerance evidence

fit.note: Protrusion excludes bolt length/nut tolerances and locking-device changes. Use exact hardware drawing before final length/torque. Socket trial OD1.25in leaves.125in at cheek; exact socket profile and axial insertion access still require trial.
